implemented_subsets.scope: Closes the text boundary left open by T06b2aw for the input unit only as far as needed: p6_tcstol/_tcstol/_tstol/_tstoi (ASCII whitespace, sign, base 0 or 2..36, defined saturation with ERANGE, no libc locale) checked against strtol in the C locale over a fixed 40000-string corpus; and _stprintf as C++ array-bounded snprintf (always terminated, truncation reported by the return value, partial UTF-8 tail removed, printf format checking). rtc_and_seed.semantics: cia.cpp::clock_bget y rtc.cpp leen hora civil. CP_A500 con Slow RAM activa MSM6242B. Reemplazar por epoca sync-config + ciclos emulados y calendario/offset fijos; no quitar RTC. main::uaerandomizeseed exige seed explicita. TOD hack/autoswitch y cache temporal zfile se excluyen. Algunas ocurrencias time son variables, no llamadas.

implementation.contract: Proleptic Gregorian years1..9999, Unix whole seconds, integer subsecond/rate, explicit int32 adjustment. No leap seconds/DST/TZ/locale. init/load sets epoch and nonzero normalizedseed; restore validates all fields; failures do not mutate outputs. No soft-reset reinitialization. RTC provider owns ordinary guest state and anchors to get_cycles; explicit fixed session rate, no inferred wrap/backtrack. Read errors latch and return 0xff through byte handlers; bridge must reject the frame using p6_rtc_status. Init only load; normal RTC reset preserves clock. Save syncs remainder, restore validates civil fields/rate and scheduler anchor; counter rebase is explicit.
implementation.seed: T06b2bo: main.cpp completo compila; P6 uaerandomizeseed pasa currprefs.seed a uaesetrandseed (0->1), sin getlocaltime. PRNG xorshift32 y globals randseed/xorshiftstate intactos; pruebas O0/O2 de secuencia/reanudacion frente a pristine con entrada normalizada. No snapshot real.
remaining: T06c/T07 wire rtc_time init/unload/status at public lifecycle boundaries: rate=CHIPSET_CLOCK_PAL/NTSC*CYCLE_UNIT fixed per session, no per-frame nominal increments. Native state restores scheduler and RTC anchor together; explicit rebase if resetting the counter. End-to-end p6_* not yet implemented.
T06c must pass explicit validated sync-config seed into currprefs.seed at load. No reseeding on restore/soft reset; 64-bit public field range/identity still requires validation.
TOD_HACK excluded by patch0011; CIA/RTC time/localtime replaced by patch0012. Battery file export remains rejected by immutable VFS, not a supported persistence backend.
T13/T15 validate sync config on load/restore and serialize live PRNG, RTC fields/anchor and chip registers; actual Waterbox snapshots and deterministic frame traces remain pending.

disk_asset_implementation.contract: Explicit blob ID only, kind ADF, rb. Outputs reset on failure; CRC stream errors return0 and errno. Caller owns distinct MAX_DPATH output buffer. excluded.configuration_text: out_config/write_* and read_slot/readevent/read_inputdevice_config, getqual/getnum/getstring, inputdevice_uaelib(text). Configuration arrives as a p6 config struct, not text.
excluded.custom_events: handle_custom_event macro language (delay/shellexec/dbg/kbr/evt, cfgfile_parse_line fallback) and its four call sites; delayed_events and iq->custom are therefore always empty.
excluded.port_scripts: generate_jport_custom_item, inputdevice_generate_jport_custom, inputdevice_jportcustom_fixup, inputdevice_parse_jport_custom and their callers; the legacy '#' conversion in inputdevice_fix_prefs. Public config must reject JSEM_CUSTOM ids.
excluded.desktop: RTG mouse offset, debugger test in the CPU-tracer shortcut, master volume/mute actions, next/previous disk actions, wall-clock joystick auto-switch (public config must reject input_autoswitchleftright), widget-name hex suffix.

input_logical_devices.changed: gethidvals2: sscanf(%X) replaced by the bounded parse. Same result for real ids; values above INT_MAX or negative report unknown (-1) instead of the raw unsigned bits (tested).
tests: tests.host.test_input_source: O0/O2 object, kept/excluded symbols, exact forbidden imports, depfile, HID parse against the legacy sscanf
input_logical_devices.limits: Providers are real but the bridge->port wiring, lag and key ordering are T10. Device-to-port assignment must follow config-invariants.json. One upstream warning remains (dst[i].custom).

providers.devices: 1 keyboard (128 key widgets = Amiga raw scancodes), 1 mouse (X/Y relative axes, 3 buttons), 2 joysticks (X/Y digital axes, 3 buttons); joystick n serves Amiga port n. Fixed ASCII names, compile-time tables, no state, no allocation.
providers.contract: The bridge pushes state once per video unit through the engine setters (inputdevice_do_keyboard, setjoystickstate, setjoybuttonstate, setmousestate, setmousebuttonstate). read() has nothing to poll; acquire/unacquire succeed for existing devices because a logical device is always available. The keyboard init must call inputdevice_setkeytranslation (nothing else does). Caps Lock is a latch bit of the bridge bitmap (ID_FLAG_TOGGLE dropped, target_checkcapslock returns 0).
tests: tests.host.test_input_devices: probe of tables and mappings under ASan/UBSan, and the real patched inputdevice.cpp/keybuf.cpp on top of the providers (default prefs, four port layouts, 128 keys direct and mapped, reset chord)
providers.for_T10: Lag must be counted at guest reads (JOYxDAT, POTGOR, CIA fire lines, get_next_key), not at read(). Define per-frame key order (keybuf holds 256 entries and drops on overflow), Caps Lock latch ownership, keys held through a reset, and the state outside snapshots (static float fract in setmousestate, mouse_axis[], keybuf[256]).

video_presentation_provider.defines: lockscr, unlockscr, render_screen, show_screen, graphics_leave, graphics_reset, check_prefs_changed_gfx, target_graphics_buffer_update, updatedisplayarea, getgfxoffset, max_uae_width, max_uae_height, flashscreen, gfx_hdr
video_presentation_provider.buffer: One static XRGB8888 buffer of 1824x626 (stride 7296, 4.36 MiB in BSS), zeroed at init; capacity derived from the engine's own arithmetic (custom.cpp compute_framesync), to be measured by T08. A mode beyond it is refused before any write (lockscr fails, p6_video_status reports it).
video_presentation_provider.bridge_calls: p6_video_init once per load after custom_init/init_m68k and before the first m68k reset; per unit p6_video_status then p6_video_present and p6_video_frame_get; p6_video_clear at p6_reset; p6_video_rebind after any native state load. graphics_setup/graphics_init are not called by any compiled unit and are replaced by p6_video_init. The compiled engine never calls render_screen/show_screen (only the dead full_redraw_all does), so the hand-over is driven by the bridge.
video_presentation_provider.guard: gfxboard_refresh is referenced only under picasso_on, never set without graphics boards; drawing.cpp guards it with PICASSO96 (0058).
tests: tests.host.test_video_present: lock/unlock/render/show sequences, byte order of an XRGB pixel through the real gfxutil.cpp, frame and pass counters, active rectangle, oversize rejection, idempotence; object exports and imports
video_presentation_provider.for_T08: Crop and aspect (active rectangle is the whole raster), interlace fields (gfx_iscanlines default 1; map interlace/long-field to P6_FIELD_EVEN/ODD), HAM/EHB micro-ROM proofs, genlock invisibility, measure the capacity maxima, discard policy and X byte, and what p6_run_frame returns when a unit ends without a new drawing pass. init_row_map keeps static caches (drawing.cpp:1309-1327) that survive unload/load: part of the T13/T15 re-init inventory.

allocation.semantics: memory.cpp bancos Chip/Slow/ROM, overlay/alias24bit y temporales; deshabilitar NATMEM/JIT. Fallo de asignacion aborta carga, no retorna objeto falso. Eliminar ruta mman host directa si no requerida.
allocation.native: Alloc portable con tamaño/alineacion y limpieza; conservar mapa bancado y semantica upstream.
allocation.waterbox: Heaps guest con permisos compatibles16K y memoria causal dentro del snapshot.
allocation.test: T05 HOST01 bounds/alias/reset y fallo de alloc; WB03/WB14 mirrors y protecciones/grupos16K.

text_helpers.semantics: Conversion y normalizacion de strings/rutas virtuales; ownership malloc/free exacto, longitud en bytes/caracteres sin truncado silencioso ni locale host. my_trim/strdup_trim ya son helpers de main.
text_helpers.native: Helpers locales UTF-8, sin resolver filesystem ni enlaces simbolicos.
text_helpers.waterbox: Misma representacion y errores, memoria guest.
text_helpers.test: T05 HOST01 UTF-8, vacio, limite y malformado; T12 ruta virtual no escapa del paquete.

engine_internal.semantics: Identificadores observados en headers/prefijos que son internos, no servicios host. main aporta prefs/PRNG/lifecycle; gfxutil colores. Rutas FPU/RTG excluidas; bridge reemplaza entrypoint CLI sin duplicar scheduler.
engine_internal.native: Mantener implementaciones upstream requeridas, condicionar features fuera de perfil.
engine_internal.waterbox: Misma semantica en guest, una instancia por sandbox.
engine_internal.test: T13 LIFE01 carga/reset/unload; T07 STEP01 solo p6_run_frame; T08 AV01 colores/T11 AV02 filtro.

lifecycle.semantics: Entradas main/custom contienen lifecycle host. Mantener orden devices_reset/memory/CIA/DISK; aislar proceso/window/restart. El bridge devuelve estado/error y no ejecuta exit ni nuevo proceso.
lifecycle.native: Implementacion neutral de carga/reset/unload con ownership verificado.
lifecycle.waterbox: Igual, estado de sandbox reiniciable y sin punteros fuera del guest.
lifecycle.test: T13 LIFE01 repetir carga/reset/fallo/unload sin fuga ni instancia residual; BUSY en segunda instancia nativa.

shared_state_implementation.contract: Keep shared state globals/writers/readers/free. P6 excludes desktop quick-slot and CD chunk export; bounded version formatting preserves header bytes. Diagnostic formats match size_t, uae_u32 and ptrdiff_t.
shared_state_implementation.test: tests.host.test_savestate_source whole objects O0/O2 -Werror=format and real header prefix/writers versus pristine with observed chunk boundary, ASan/UBSan; CMake Debug/Release.
shared_state_implementation.remaining: Legacy quick callers, restore CD/other devices, replay, configuration, path and screenshot imports require closure. Header descriptions remain legacy-bounded, public validation and native serializer/restore await T15; Waterbox snapshot is a separate gate.
